title: Generalizable Equivariant Diffusion Models for Non-Abelian Lattice Gauge Theory: Analytical Foundations and Numerical Scaling Tests
abstract: arXiv:2611.03530v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gauge-equivariant diffusion models can be used to generate ensembles of field configurations in non-abelian lattice gauge theories. Previously, we demonstrated the feasibility of modeling these theories by combining L-CNN-based diffusion models with the Metropolis-adjusted annealed Langevin algorithm (MAALA). Here we focus on the underlying analytical framework. In particular, we present a rigorous derivation of the reverse-time stochastic differential equation on the group manifold, discuss the gauge invariance of the denoising loss function, and provide extensive numerical benchmarks regarding the scaling behavior with respect to the lattice volume and the inverse coupling $\beta$. Full analytical expressions for arbitrarily sized Wilson loops and the topological charge susceptibility during the forward process are given as well.

translated_title: 面向非阿贝尔格点规范理论的可泛化等变扩散模型：分析基础与数值标度测试
translated_abstract: 规范等变扩散模型可用于生成非阿贝尔格点规范理论中的场构型系综。此前，我们通过将基于L-CNN的扩散模型与Metropolis修正的退火朗之万算法（MAALA）相结合，证明了建模此类理论的可行性。本文重点研究其背后的分析框架。具体而言，我们对群流形上的逆时随机微分方程进行了严格推导，讨论了去噪损失函数的规范不变性，并针对晶格体积与逆耦合常数β的标度行为提供了大量的数值基准测试。此外，文中还给出了前向扩散过程中任意尺寸Wilson环以及拓扑荷磁化率的完整解析表达式。
tldr: 本文为非阿贝尔格点规范理论中的规范等变扩散模型建立了严格的分析框架，包括群流形上逆时随机微分方程的推导、去噪损失的规范不变性论证，以及关于晶格体积和耦合常数标度行为的系统性数值验证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a rigorous analytical foundation for gauge-equivariant diffusion models in non-Abelian lattice gauge theory, including a derivation of the reverse-time SDE on the group manifold, a proof of gauge invariance of the denoising loss, and extensive numerical scaling benchmarks with respect to lattice volume and inverse coupling.
